title: Notification Queue Backlog Causing Processing Delays
customerImpact: Up to 25 minutes of additional processing time for notifications enqueued between 16:02 and 17:30 UTC. No notifications were dropped; the backlog is draining.

updates.author: Danilo Okafor, SRE
updates.details: We detected a growing backlog in the notification delivery queues. Workers are consuming at a lower rate than expected.

updates.author: Danilo Okafor, SRE
updates.details: A PostgreSQL primary replica fell behind on checkpoint I/O, increasing query latency for the worker fleet. No data loss; replication is catching up.

updates.author: Amina Yusuf, SRE
updates.details: Checkpoint tuning applied and the replica has caught up. Queue depth is falling steadily. We are monitoring until the backlog fully drains.
updates.customerImpact: Backlog estimated to drain within 30 minutes. Affected notifications will deliver in enqueue order.
